coverage: 15 first-level units (seven states, seven regions and Nay Pyi Taw union territory), plus all 330 MIMU townships. Bago and Shan source subregions are combined into their actual first-level parents. Administrative geography does not imply current military control. The separate control overview identifies approximate IISS reference territories and dated military centres, keeping unclassified/mixed areas neutral. Current district reorganisations are not consistently covered and are not exposed. 2014 official census populations are historical, include source estimates for some non-enumerated areas, and are not current population counts. Coastlines and local names follow MIMU PCode v9.4 at source scale 1:250,000; inland lakes excluded. Shared land frontiers follow existing atlas India, Thailand and China outlines.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
